title: Puck counters ceilings (puck.counters.ceilings.v1)
description: A puck.counters.ceilings.v1 document: the counted-cost ceilings puck counters --check holds the counters workload to, pass by pass, and puck counters --record writes. Each backend's run states, for every pass of every render node and for the work outside every pass, what each GPU submission kind may read there: at most its ceiling, where a ceiling of zero is a required zero. A deterministic kind is judged on any device; a per-backend-deterministic kind (PerBackendDeterministic) only on the device its run was recorded on, and is reported as not judged on any other, except a zero that is a structural contract (RequiredZero), which holds on every device and is judged on every one.

backend.description: The backend the ceilings were recorded on: vulkan or directx.

device.description: The device they were recorded on, which a per-backend-deterministic ceiling is judged on alone.
device.title: GpuDeviceIdentity

width.description: The offscreen presentation's width in pixels.

height.description: The offscreen presentation's height in pixels.

ceilings.description: Every pass's ceiling for every kind, in the order the run reported the counts.

items.description: What one kind may read in one pass of one render node, or in the work outside its every pass.

pass.description: The pass, or null for the work outside every pass.

kind.description: The GPU submission kind's dotted name.

class.description: What the count was recorded as: the kind's class, loosened to its pass's.
class.title: WorkClass

ceiling.description: The most the count may read; zero requires it to read zero.

requiredZero.description: Whether the ceiling is a zero that holds on every device: the kind is a magnitude that varies with the device (a kernel kind such as the march steps), and the pass never does that kind of work, so zero is a structural contract and not one device's reading. A per-backend-deterministic ceiling is judged on a foreign device only when it is a required zero. Only a zero ceiling of a per-backend-deterministic class carries it; a deterministic ceiling is judged everywhere by its class, and a count loosened to its pass's class is a reading of the recording device alone.
